classes.name: Classless Wretch
classes.flavor: No calling, no credentials, no future.

classes.name: Fanged Deserter
classes.flavor: Bite attack (d6). Done taking orders, still taking fingers.

classes.name: Gutterborn Scum
classes.flavor: Born in filth, fluent in worse.

classes.name: Esoteric Hermit
classes.flavor: Alone with the secrets everyone else was spared.

classes.name: Wretched Royalty
classes.flavor: A crown of debts and delusions.

provisions.name: Waterskin and {days} days of food
provisions.flavor: One hand holds your silver. The other holds this.

containers.name: No container
containers.flavor: Whatever you can carry in your arms.

gear_a.name: Unclean scroll
gear_a.flavor: The ink moves when you aren't reading.

stats.effect: Agility DR14 to avoid slipping, d6 damage
opened: nearby test Agility DR16 or infected
Toughness DR10 or rotgut: no food or drink until cured

gear_b.name: Sacred scroll
gear_b.flavor: Holy words in an unholy age.

gear_b.name: Cartography kit
gear_b.flavor: Half the maps are wrong. Which half?

stats.armor: -1 damage, or break shield to ignore one attack

unclean_scrolls.name: Palms of the Drowned
unclean_scrolls.flavor: Dead water rises to your knees and obeys.

unclean_scrolls.name: Teeth of the Field
unclean_scrolls.flavor: The ground bites whoever you point at.

unclean_scrolls.name: Sixth Whisper
unclean_scrolls.flavor: One creature hears a truth it cannot unhear.

unclean_scrolls.name: Gnaw
unclean_scrolls.flavor: Rot spreads from your touch. d6 damage, it lingers.

unclean_scrolls.name: The Crooked Candle
unclean_scrolls.flavor: All flames within sight bend toward your enemy.

unclean_scrolls.name: Skin of Nails
unclean_scrolls.flavor: Your skin sprouts iron. -d2 to incoming damage, briefly.

unclean_scrolls.name: Undertow
unclean_scrolls.flavor: Drag a creature one room in any direction.

sacred_scrolls.name: Grace of a Dead Saint
sacred_scrolls.flavor: Heal d6 HP. The saint watches you spend it.

sacred_scrolls.name: Litany of Holding
sacred_scrolls.flavor: A door, chest or jaw stays shut until dawn.

sacred_scrolls.name: Unshakeable Rest
sacred_scrolls.flavor: One creature sleeps through anything short of harm.

sacred_scrolls.name: The Honest Light
sacred_scrolls.flavor: Illusions and lies glow faintly violet.

sacred_scrolls.name: Word Against Iron
sacred_scrolls.flavor: One weapon refuses to strike you this day.

sacred_scrolls.name: Psalm of the Last Road
sacred_scrolls.flavor: The shortest path reveals itself. Not the safest.

sacred_scrolls.name: Benediction
sacred_scrolls.flavor: Next test: roll twice, keep the better.

sacred_scrolls.name: Censer of the Untainted
sacred_scrolls.flavor: Poison and plague hold their breath near you.

bodies.name: One hand replaced with rusting hook

bodies: Cataracts slowly but surely spreading in both eyes.
Long tangled hair, at least one cockroach in residence.
Juddering and stuttering from nerve damage or stress.
One hand lacks thumb and index finger, grips like a lobster.
Resting maniac face, making friends is hard.
Recently slashed and stinking eye covered with a patch.
Nails cracked and black, maybe about to drop off.
habits: Obsessively collect small sharp stones.
Won't use a blade without testing it on your own flesh.
Can't stop drinking once you start.
Gambling addict. Must bet every day. If you lose, raise and bet again.
Cannot tolerate criticism. Results in rage and weeping.
Unable to get to the point. Have never actually finished a story.
Best friend is a skull. Carry it, tell it everything, trust no one more.
You pick your nose so deep it bleeds.
Laugh hysterically at your own jokes, which you then explain in detail.
A nihilist. You insist on telling everyone and explaining why.
Inveterate bug eater.
Stress response is aesthetic display. The worse it gets, the fancier you need to be.
Permanent phlegm deposit in throat. Cough, snort, spit, swallow.
Pyromaniac.
Consistently lose important items and forget vital facts.
Insecure shit-stirrer. Will talk about whoever just left the room.
You stutter when lying.
You giggle insanely at the worst possible times.
You whistle while trying to hide. You will deny this.
You make jewelry from the teeth of the dead. If that's a bad habit.
